title: Red Callender Publishing and Mary Lou as singer and pilot
summary: Callender says his wife heads his publishing company and praises her many talents.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, you're obviously adding some more to the list, with those originals I heard at your concert.
Oh, yeah. I've got a few more.
Is Mary Lou in ASCAP yet?

She will be, as soon as... Yeah, she practically is, because she did the lyric on this thing, so that's... Anyhow, she's the head of my publishing company. I have a publishing company called Red Callender Publishing, and that's represented by Mary Lou.
Mary Lou, we should mention is a singer.
